# BricoHams · LibreSat LSR-2: materials and cost budget, SARCTrac Mk4 replica (generated by calc/lsr2_materials.py)

<!-- palette: blue #12263f, orange #e8871e -->
Authors: Anatol EA5KAO, Diego EA5JEF, Pedro Roca Molina.

Design `LSR2_DESIGN=mk4` (default). **Single source:** made-part masses come only from `build/lsr2_build_report.json` (finished solids of the SARCNET Mk4 files, one value per part), bought-part masses (catalogue or est.) and all costs from `calc/lsr2_mk4_bom.py`; `scripts/bom.py` writes [BOM_LSR2](BOM_LSR2.md) from the same function, so both documents carry the same total mass, cost and buy-in quantities. Blank estimates: sheet = part rectangle (bounding box) + 30 % nesting; plate blank = bounding box + 5 mm per side; 10 mm cut-off per sawn or turned piece; stainless bar = largest step + 3 mm.

## Scope of the mass total

Included: rotator head (10 mm mounting plate, 2 mm covers, corner blocks, enclosure, platform), electronics housing with the drivers and controller, the two gearbox + motor assemblies, lift arms (the report solid includes the steel counterweight leaf of the SARCNET part file), saddle with U-bolts and clamp bars, thrust bearing stack, mast bracket and all fasteners. Excluded: mast, antennas, cables (including the 8 m motor/sensor cable) and the indoor 48 V PSU. The cost total of [BOM_LSR2](BOM_LSR2.md) includes the PSU and the cable. The pipe clamps and end stops are catalogue parts: the report models them as simplified solids, the catalogue mass is used.

## Cast variant

The earlier cast/CNC open-box design (route A / route B comparison, shafts, own LSR-WG30 gearbox) is optional and is generated by this script with `LSR2_DESIGN=cast` (build the cast variant first, then `python calc/lsr2_materials.py`).
